summary: Excellent. Workflow follows all GitHub Actions conventions: pinned action refs (actions/checkout@v4), least-privilege permissions, proper triggers, explicit error handling with exit codes, idempotent bash using set -euo pipefail, and clean job dependency modeling. matrix_generator.py implements the cartesian-product-then-exclude-then-include algorithm correctly, matches GitHub's documented behavior, includes thorough config validation with actionable error messages, uses type hints and deterministic JSON output (sort_keys=True). No dead code, clear separation of concerns, well-documented with docstrings explaining the WHY. Ready to ship.
